## Summary

Describe what changed and why it matters.

## Validation

- [ ] `python -m pytest`
- [ ] `python -m ruff check .`
- [ ] `authorstyle --help`

## Checklist

- [ ] User-facing behavior is documented.
- [ ] Architecture or methodology changes are documented in `docs/`.
- [ ] The workflow remains local-first by default.
- [ ] No private corpus content is included in fixtures or examples.
- [ ] Style and content remain separated in the design.
